response.original_title: Silversea Cruise Booking Update: How to Add an Additional Room
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Silversea Cruise +1-866-254-7549, you must create a separate booking by calling Silversea Customer Service +1-866-254-7549 or contacting your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Step-by-Step ProcessContact Support: Call Silversea customer support at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or reach out to your travel advisor. Book a Separate Cabin: An agent will set up a new +1-866-254-7549, independent reservation for the additional stateroom based on current ship availability and pricing. Link Reservations: +1-866-254-7549 Ask the representative to officially link the new booking number to your original reservation.
